ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 38
   B. 19
   C. 30
   D. 60

2. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 81

3. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 26
   C. 13
   D. 169

4. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

5. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 25

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 15
   C. 21
   D. 17

7. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 2/2
   C. 1/4
   D. They are equal

8. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.7
   C. 31.6
   D. 31

9. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

10. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 24.5

11. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 29
   C. 23.6
   D. 23.7

12. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.6
   C. 27.7
   D. 27

13. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

14. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

15. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 26

16. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 11
   C. 3
   D. 29

17. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 36
   C. 13
   D. 37

18. Solve for x: x + 8 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 13
   C. 8
   D. 6

19. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 24
   C. 5
   D. 11

20. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 43
   D. 2

21. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 2
   C. 14
   D. 49

22. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 11
   C. 22
   D. 122

23. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 50
   C. 7
   D. 14

24. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2, 4, 6
   B. 1, 6
   C. 3, 6, 9
   D. 1, 2, 3, 6

25. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 44
   C. 30
   D. 15

26. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 36

27. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 24

28. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19
   C. 19.6
   D. 19.7

29. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 37
   D. 1

30. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.6
   C. 15
   D. 15.7
